---
title: Review Refund Settings
description: Configure the global percentage of order credits refunded to vendors when their uploaded customer review is accepted, and turn the feature on or off.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Money → **Review Refund Settings** (`/settings/review-refund`). Also reachable from the **Refund Settings** button on the Review Refunds screen.

This screen controls how many credits a vendor gets back when an admin accepts their uploaded customer review on **Review Refunds**.

## What the screen shows

A single **Global Refund Percentage** card:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Refund percentage (%)** | Applied to every accepted review: **refund = order credits × this %**. Helper text gives an example, e.g. at 5% a 100-credit order → vendor gets 5 credits. |
| **Feature enabled** | Toggle with an **Active** badge when on. When off, accepting a review records no refund. |
| **Save Settings** | Saves both fields. |

## Changing the refund percentage

<Steps>
<Step title="Open the settings" icon="settings" title-type="p">
Go to **Vendors → Review Refund Settings**.
</Step>
<Step title="Update the values" icon="percent" title-type="p">
Enter the new **Refund percentage (%)** and/or switch **Feature enabled** on or off.
</Step>
<Step title="Save" icon="save" title-type="p">
Click **Save Settings**. The new rate appears in the Review Refunds subtitle ("Current refund: X% of order credits").
</Step>
</Steps>

<Callout kind="info">
The percentage is global — it applies to every review accepted after the change. Reviews accepted earlier keep the refund that was credited at the time.
</Callout>
